title: Finite affine free cover with zero cokernel
statement: Let X be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme, Λ a finite commutative ring, and F a constructible module sheaf on X_et. With P_W the sheafification of the free Λ-module presheaf represented by W, there exist finitely many affine etale objects U_i and a morphism g : ⨿_i P_{U_i} ⟶ F whose cokernel is a zero object.

source.place: Tag 095N, proof of the finite surjection through the constructible-topology argument.

proof.text: Index all pairs (W,f) with W affine etale and f:P_W→F. For every finite subset S take g_S=Sigma.desc of its maps. Each P_W is constructible by the free-shriek comparison and constructibility of affine etale extensions. Enumerate S by Fin(card S), apply IsConstructibleSheaf.biproduct, and transport along biproduct.isoCoproduct and Sigma.reindex. Finite sums are constructible (also following from the extension clause of the Serre theorem). Apply the failure-locus theorem to g_S.

For each x take its algebraic geometric point. Its module stalk is finitely generated by constructibleModule_finite_geometric_stalk. Apply finite affine stalk generation to choose S whose stalk map is surjective at x. Hence the intersection of all failure loci E_S is empty.

Construct SpectralSpace X from the Mathlib scheme instances, compactness, and quasi-separatedness. Apply finite_subfamily_iInter_eq_empty_of_isConstructible to obtain finitely many finite sets of maps with empty intersection of failure loci. Let S be their finset biUnion.

At every x some selected K has surjective stalk map. Since K⊆S, Sigma.desc of the inclusions into the S-coproduct gives t_K with t_K≫g_S=g_K, proved by Sigma.hom_ext. To cancel g_S against two arbitrary maps a,b, apply sheafHom_ext_of_sheafFiber_map_algClosurePoint and cancel the surjective module stalk of g_K. Functor.map_comp and associativity transport the assumed equality through t_K. Thus g_S is epi.

Enumerate S by Fin(card S). Precompose g_S with Sigma.reindex of this equivalence; its source is exactly the required finite affine free coproduct and the map remains epi. isZero_cokernel_of_epi supplies the zero cokernel. Return the enumeration, its affine witnesses, the map, and the zero-object witness. Empty S and empty X require no special case.

lean.statement: theorem exists_affine_free_etale_zero_cokernel (X : Scheme.{u}) [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X] (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ] (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) (hF : IsConstructibleEtaleModuleSheaf F) : let P : X.Etale → Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) := fun W => (presheafToSheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj (uliftYoneda.{u + 1}.obj W ⋙ ModuleCat.free Λ) ∃ (n : ℕ) (U : Fin n → X.Etale), (∀ i, IsAffine (U i).left) ∧ ∃ g : (∐ fun i : Fin n => P (U i)) ⟶ F, Nonempty (IsZero (cokernel g))
